Are you the one 
 Elevator and Escalator Technician in the Netherlands 
TK Elevator Netherlands BV - Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands 
 Who we are 
Are you an experienced Elevator and/or Escalator Technician? Are you looking for a new challenge abroad and are you excited about the idea of relocating to the Netherlands for a stable and well-paid technical career? Are you interested in working specifically in Repair or Modernization? Do you have a professional working proficiency of the English language? If so, TK Elevator Netherlands is looking for you! 
Job Description 
We have both Modernization as Repair poisitions open in Elevators and Escalators. If you have experience in either, please feel invited to apply. 
In our Modernization (MOD) team, you will disassemble our clients' elevator/escalator (parts), and then upgrade, renew and assemble them within existing buildings and infrastructure. This includes a very broad variety of tasks, such as f.e.: replacing control panels, engines, installing new doors, and updating machines and control systems. 
In our Repair (REP) team, you will perform (big) repairs on elevators/escalators, from reparation works on engines, step chains or handrails, electrical components, cables, etc. 
For both jobs you will work at a diverse set of locations such as train stations, shopping centers, offices, and museums. Every day is different, offering a dynamic and hands-on role for those who enjoy both mechanical and electrical work. 
With approximately 280 employees, TK Elevator Netherlands B.V. is currently one of the larger elevator and escalator companies in the Netherlands and installs, maintains and repairs elevators, escalators and automatic doors of various types and sizes. TK Elevator Netherlands B.V. has the mission to become the best service organization for elevators, escalators and automatic doors in the Netherlan...

Do you enjoy working with your hands and like creating something tangible from a technical drawing? Then this Production Worker position in Son could be a great fit for you. For a client specialized in custom-made packaging solutions, we are looking for a motivated employee who wants to help produce wooden crates and industrial packaging. Experience is less important than technical insight and the motivation to learn the trade. In return, you will receive a gross hourly wage of €15.42, travel allowance, pension accrual, and the opportunity to be hired directly by the client. Read on!

As a Production Worker, your tasks will include:

    - Producing custom-made wooden crates and industrial packaging
    
- Working from technical drawings and work instructions
    
- Processing and assembling wooden components using hand tools and power tools
    
- Building complete packaging constructions for a wide range of products
    
- Performing quality checks during the production process
    
- Maintaining a safe and tidy workplace

What’s in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €15.42
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre (reimbursed from 6 kilometres up to a maximum of 40 kilometres one way)
    
- Full-time position of 40 hours per week
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Opportunity for a direct contract with the client upon good performance

    - Technical insight and an interest in working with wood and tools
    
- Ability to read technical drawings or willingness to learn
    
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
    
- Physical fitness for work that involves regular lifting and moving of materials

Would you like to work as a Production Worker in Son and learn how custom-made packaging solutions are created for a wide range of industries? Apply today through Manpower.
